name: Telecom NOC & Field Network Dispatch
description: Suppresses downstream network alarm storms via parent-child topology graph correlation, validates technician climbing/safety certifications and van/depot spares prior to field dispatch, and classifies B2B enterprise provisioning order fallout by queue and MRC-at-risk.

skills.summary: Traces upstream parent-child network graphs to suppress downstream alarm storms and roll up impacted subscribers and VIP circuits.
Validates technician skills and non-expired safety certs as of dispatch date alongside depot/van spare kit stock before truck rolls.
Classifies stuck B2B DIA/MPLS/SIP orders into deterministic remediation queues and quantifies Monthly Recurring Charge (MRC) at risk.
